**Finding submitted: MISSING (medium severity)**

**What I checked.** The agreement has no dedicated termination/exit section beyond Section 14 (p0079), which merely continues Hosting and Support Services to the end of the month following notice. Section 13 (p0078) confirms Client retains ownership of its domains and Client Content, but places the entire exit burden on us — arranging a new name server within 30 days and a new hosting environment within 60 days. The confidentiality section (sec-10) contains no return-of-materials or destruction hook, and searches for "return"/data export/deletion turned up nothing relevant.

**Why it fails.** There is no TrueLink obligation to (a) assist with migration, (b) return Client Content, borrower and loan data in a usable format, or (c) delete data and certify deletion. That is below even the fallback position (90 days' assistance plus export within 30 days), so this is an insert rather than a note.

**Redline (validated ok:true).** New Section 14a inserted immediately after the Termination section, at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. Placement is deliberate — the survival clause in p0090 covers "Sections 1 and 5 through 30," so 14a survives termination automatically without further amendment. The comment flags 90 days of assistance as an acceptable fallback if TrueLink pushes back.
